newsitem.title: GERMANY: Condor plans to order 12 Boeing 757s.
newsitem.headline: Condor plans to order 12 Boeing 757s.

text.p: Condor Flugdiens GmbH, the charter carrier of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, said on Monday it planned to place confirmed orders for 12 Boeing 757-300s, an extended version of the 757-200.
In a statement issued by the company, Condor said the total value of the investment was one billion marks. The group would issue options to pay for the new planes.

Six of the twelve planes will replace the current fleet of DC-10-30s in operation on short- and medium-haul routes, while the rest will be used to expand the fleet to cope with expanded demand for holiday flights.
The options issue needs the approval of the supervisory boards of both Condor and Lufthansa in the autumn before it can go ahead.
Condor will be the first charter airline in the world to order this new type of aeroplane.
